title: Client state unlock bypasses authentication - no server verification
reasoning: The entire portal access control is client-side state (`unlocked`). An attacker can trivially bypass this by opening DevTools console and running `setUnlocked(true)` or modifying React component state. There is no server-side session or token validation. All portal content and functionality is accessible without any real authentication barrier.
reproduction: Load MarkPortal.tsx in a browser, open console, find the React component instance, and set `unlocked` state to true, bypassing the PIN entirely.
recommendation: Implement server-side authentication. The portal content should only be served or accessible after successful server-side PIN verification and session establishment. Use HTTP-only cookies or tokens for session management.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests exist. This is a fundamental architecture issue requiring manual security review or penetration testing.
suggestedRegressionTest: Attempt to access portal content without valid server session and verify access is denied.
minimumFixScope: src/src/pages/MarkPortal.tsx - refactor to server-side authentication and session management
